_README: Curated review decisions for detached polygon parts ('outliers') flagged
by scripts/audit_geometry_outliers.py. This file is the human-reviewed
ledger — NOT a place to silently bury problems. Two sections:
clip      — per appellation slug, a list of polygon parts confirmed to be
SPURIOUS (an upstream-data error). Stage 04 drops the matching
part from the resolved geometry and logs every clip. The audit
independently re-verifies each entry against the SOURCE data
every run: a clip that still matches a real part reports as
CONFIRMED; a clip that no longer matches (upstream data drifted
or was fixed) reports as STALE with a loud warning to re-verify.
whitelist — per appellation slug, appellations whose detached parts are
LEGITIMATE (archipelagos, multi-region DOs). The audit lists
them as ACCEPTED rather than UNREVIEWED. Whitelisting suppresses
outlier flagging for the WHOLE slug, so only use it for
appellations whose every detached part has been reviewed.
A clip entry matches a part when its 3035-centroid is within `match_tol_km`
of `centroid_latlon` AND its area is within `area_tol_pct` of `area_km2`.
Exactly one part must match — zero or several is reported as STALE and the
part is NOT clipped (fail loud, never guess).
A clip's `geom_source` names the resolver whose output it applies to (stage 04
skips the clip when another resolver won the record). `file_number` lets the
audit re-derive a `figshare-pdo` clip against EU_PDO.gpkg. A clip on a
`gisco-nuts-region` union has no Bétard polygon: its signatures are taken from
the union of the GISCO NUTS polygons the record resolves to (raw/gr/nuts,
raw/nl/nuts), which is the geometry stage 04 clips.
Every clip entry must cite a public, checkable reason: what the part is, why
it does not belong, and what it overlaps. `verified` is the review date.

drop.reason: Fragment 225 km W of Lake Garda, near Avigliana (Piedmont). Lies 100% inside the Piemonte regional DOC (PDO-IT-A1224). The Garda disciplinare restricts the DOC to the provinces of Brescia, Mantova and Verona — no Piedmont component exists. Bétard 2022 EU_PDO.gpkg cross-attribution error.

Fragment 57 km SE of the Kvarner / Vinodol main body. It is the whole LAU of Skradin (GISCO HR_03948, 184.3 km2, Šibenik-Knin) and lies inside Dalmatinska zagora (PDO-HR-A1648) and Primorska Hrvatska. The MPS product specification (poljoprivreda.gov.hr, Hrvatsko_primorje.doc, 'Granice područja') does not list Skradin. It lists Lovran … Bakar, Bribir, Crikvenica, Novi Vinodolski, Vinodolska općina … Senj plus the islands Krk, Rab, Cres, Lošinj, Susak, Pag and Vir, with Bribir placed in vinogorje Opatija-Rijeka-Vinodol. The MPS Dalmatinska zagora spec lists Skradin. Bétard 2022 EU_PDO.gpkg cross-attribution, most likely from the Vinodol 'Bribir' being matched to a namesake place in Skradin.

Δ.Κ. Πλατάνου of the Aigialeia municipality (GISCO LAU EL_37020312, 21.2 km²; 96 % of the part), on the Gulf of Corinth coast at Akrata, ~28 km E of the Rio main body. The ΥΠΑΑΤ product specification (raw/gr/national-specs-extracted/moschatos-riou-patras.json, geo_area_brief; Β.Δ. 386/1971 as amended by Π.Δ. 242/1982) says the zone 'εκτείνεται κυρίως στην περιοχή Ρίου (Άγιος Βασίλειος, Άγιος Γεώργιος, Άνω & Κάτω Καστρίτσι, Αργυρά, Βερναρδέικα, Δρέπανο, Πλατάνι, Ρίο, Ψαθόπυργος), ενώ μικρή έκταση είναι στο ΒΑ τμήμα της περιοχής Πατρέων' — Πλατάνι of Rio is GISCO Δ.Κ. Πλατανίου (EL_37010510, 5.8 km², in the Ρίου municipal unit 370105 with Άνω Καστριτσίου, Αργυράς and Ψαθοπύργου, which the main body covers). Bétard 2022 EU_PDO.gpkg matched the Aigialeia homonym instead and draws only 4 % of the Rio community.

The Άγιος Νικόλαος it names is the one under Λαρισσού in western Achaia (GISCO: Δ.Κ. Αγίου Νικολάου Κράλης EL_37030402 and Δ.Κ. Αγίου Νικολάου Σπάτων EL_37030202, both in the Δυτική Αχαΐα municipality 3703); Bétard 2022 EU_PDO.gpkg matched the Kalavryta homonym instead and draws neither (6 % / 0 % covered).

The ΥΠΑΑΤ product specification (raw/gr/national-specs-extracted/mavrodafni-patron.json, geo_area_brief; Β.Δ. 386/1971 as amended by Π.Δ. 201/1993) confines the PDO to 'τριών ζωνών της επαρχίας Πατρών του Νομού Αχαΐας' (NUTS 'GR232 Αχαΐα'): zone α around Patras, zone β 'του Ρίου' and zone γ west of the Arla road. The Strofades islets (Στροφάδες), ~46 km S of Zakynthos (~37.25°N, 21.01°E): the ~1.8 km² part of the NUTS-3 EL621 Ζάκυνθος polygon the record is drawn from (raw/gr/nuts/NUTS_RG_03M_2024_4326_LEVL_3.geojson); GISCO LAU Δ.Κ. Ζακυνθίων (EL_33010101) carries them (70 % of the part, the rest is the coarser NUTS coastline). The ΥΠΑΑΤ product specification (raw/gr/national-specs-extracted/zakynthos.json, geo_area_brief; ΥΑ 310945/24.12.2010, ΦΕΚ 2042/B/29.12.2010) delimits 'τις περιοχές της νήσου Ζακύνθου και σε υψόμετρο άνω των 20 μέτρων' — the island of Zakynthos itself, not the islets. There is no Bétard polygon for this PGI; the clip applies to the gisco-nuts-region union.

Gavdos (Γαύδος), ~36 km S of the Cretan coast (~34.84°N, 24.09°E): GISCO LAU Ψευδοδημοτική Κοινότητα Γαύδου (EL_74030000, 34.5 km²; 88 % of the part), NUTS-3 EL434 Χανιά. There is no Bétard polygon for this PGI; the clip applies to the gisco-nuts-region union of NUTS-2 EL43 Κρήτη (raw/nl/nuts/NUTS_RG_03M_2024_4326_LEVL_2.geojson).

whitelist.madeira: Atlantic archipelago — the DOP spans Madeira, Porto Santo and the Desertas; disjoint island parts are expected.
whitelist.madeirense: Atlantic archipelago — same island footprint as Madeira DOP.
whitelist.islas-canarias: Atlantic archipelago — the DO covers all seven Canary Islands; disjoint island parts are expected.
whitelist.sicilia: Sicily plus its minor-island groups (Pantelleria, Aeolian, Egadi, Ustica) — disjoint island parts are expected.
whitelist.cava: Spanish sparkling-wine DO produced in legally listed municipalities across Catalonia, La Rioja, Aragon, Navarra, the Basque Country, Extremadura and Valencia — genuinely multi-region and disjoint.
whitelist.saale-unstrut: German Anbaugebiet legally extended to Werder (Havel) in Brandenburg — the Werderaner Wachtelberg, Germany's northernmost vineyard. BLE Produktspezifikation §11.3 names the Brandenburg-side Gemarkungen Werder (Havel), Phöben, Plessow and Neu Töplitz; the ~117 km² polygon ~150 km NE of the main Sachsen-Anhalt body (~52.38°N, 12.88°E) is therefore legitimate, not a Bétard cross-attribution.
whitelist.english-wine: Offshore England — the detached parts are the Isles of Scilly (~40-54 km off Land's End) plus other coastal islands of the ONS England country polygon. The PDO is demarcated to ENGLAND, so they are legitimately in the area; Scilly has commercial vineyard plantings.
whitelist.english-regional-wine: Offshore England — same ONS England footprint as the English PDO.
whitelist.landwein-neckar: Landwein Neckar (PGI-DE-A1284) is drawn from the Württemberg Anbaugebiet (PDO-DE-A1276), which has a legal outpost on Lake Constance. The BLE Produktspezifikation §4 lists Kreßbronn, Ravensburg and Taldorf among its Gemeinden/Gemarkungen. §7.1 says 'Ein kleiner Bereich am Bodensee um Kressbronn ist ebenfalls Bestandteil des abgegrenzten Gebiets'. The ~710 km² lakeshore part ~36 km S of the Tübingen/Metzingen main body (~47.72°N, 9.42°E) is therefore legitimate, not a Bétard cross-attribution. Caveat: Bétard draws it at roughly district level (the whole Bodenseekreis plus Lindau/Wasserburg/Nonnenhorn/Bodolz), so it overlaps the Baden Bereich Bodensee.
whitelist.schwabischer-landwein: Württemberg-aligned Landwein with a legal Bodensee exclave. BLE Produktspezifikation 'Schwäbischer Landwein' §4 lists the Gemarkungen Kreßbronn, Ravensburg and Taldorf, and §7.1 states 'Ein kleiner Bereich am Bodensee um Kressbronn ist ebenfalls Bestandteil des abgegrenzten Gebiets'. The ~710 km² part ~36 km S of the Neckar main body (~47.72°N, 9.42°E) is the Bodensee piece of the sole union member, Württemberg PDO (PDO-DE-A1276), whose own spec §4.1/§4.2 names Kressbronn, Ravensburg and Taldorf plus Nonnenhorn, Wasserburg, Bodolz and Lindau (Hoyren, Aeschach). The part is legitimate, not a Bétard cross-attribution. Caveat: Bétard draws it at district level (the whole Bodenseekreis plus the four Lindau-district communes), so ~94% of it overlaps Baden's Bodensee Bereich, and it barely covers Ravensburg/Taldorf.
whitelist.wurttemberg: German Anbaugebiet legally extended to Lake Constance, the Württembergischer Bodensee. The EU single document (OJ C/2025/5177, section 6) lists the Baden-Württemberg Gemarkungen Kressbronn (9960), Ravensburg (9580) and Taldorf (9583). A separate Bavarian block adds the Gemeinden Nonnenhorn, Wasserburg and Bod(h)olz and the Lindau Gemarkungen Hoyren and Aeschach. The ~710 km² polygon about 36 km S of the Neckar/Tauber main body (~47.72°N, 9.42°E) is therefore legitimate, not a Bétard cross-attribution. Caveat: Bétard draws it as the whole Bodenseekreis plus the Lindau communes, which over-extends into Baden's Bereich Bodensee (Meersburg, Hagnau, Überlingen, …) and leaves out Ravensburg/Taldorf. That is a precision issue, not a spurious part.
whitelist.rheingauer-landwein: Law-listed northern-Hessen outpost: the BLE Produktspezifikation 'Rheingauer Landwein' (§3 Abgrenzung des Gebietes) lists the Stadt Felsberg (Schwalm-Eder-Kreis, the Böddiger Berg vineyard) among the Hessian Städte und Gemeinden of the area, like the Rheingau g.U. spec it mirrors. The 83 km2 part ~130 km NE of the Rhine is the Felsberg Gemeinde (LAU DE_06634003) and is expected.
whitelist.rheingau: German Anbaugebiet with a legal exclave in northern Hesse: Felsberg (Schwalm-Eder-Kreis), home of the Böddiger Berg vineyard. BLE Produktspezifikation §3 'Abgrenzung des Gebietes' names Felsberg among the Städte und Gemeinden of the PDO (Eltville am Rhein, Felsberg, Flörsheim am Main, Frankfurt am Main, …, Wiesbaden), and §8.1.1 describes the area as reaching 'bis nach Frankfurt am Main und Felsberg'. The ~83 km² part ~129 km NE of the main Rheingau body (~51.14°N, 9.45°E) is the GISCO LAU Felsberg, Stadt polygon (DE_06634003), so it is legitimate, not a Bétard cross-attribution. It overlaps only the same-family Rheingauer Landwein / Landwein Rhein PGIs, whose spec also lists Felsberg.
whitelist.viile-timisului: Multi-vineyard Timiș PGI: the EU single document (OJ C 90, 17.3.2021, PGI-RO-A0108) lists six separate podgorii, including '5. Podgoria Teremia, din judeţul Timiş, cu localităţile: Teremia Mare'. The ~84 km² part ~48 km west of the Recaș/Giarmata/Buziaș body (~45.95°N, 20.54°E) is the GISCO LAU commune Teremia Mare (RO_158859), so it is legitimate and not a homonym or parser leak.
whitelist.marc-d-alsace-gewurztraminer: Alsace northern outpost: the detached ~81 km² part (~49.01°N, 7.94°E) is the Wissembourg/Cleebourg vineyard: Cleebourg, Oberhoffen(-lès-Wissembourg), Riedseltz, Rott, Steinseltz and Wissembourg. The INAO cahier des charges of AOC Marc d'Alsace, section C (Définition de la zone géographique, Bas-Rhin commune list), names all six, and INAO's aires-communes CSV lists them under Marc d'Alsace (IDA 2132). The DGC inherits this list. The only other detached part, Kienheim (~3 km², 4 km from the main body), is also listed. The part is legitimate and is not a homonym or cross-attribution.
whitelist.alsace-suivi-d-un-nom-de-lieu-dit: Northern Alsace (Wissembourg) vineyard. The AOC Alsace cahier des charges, IV 1° a), which covers « Alsace » suivie ou non du nom d'un lieu-dit, explicitly lists Cleebourg, Oberhoffen-lès-Wissembourg, Riedseltz, Rott, Steinseltz and Wissembourg (Bas-Rhin), and INAO's aires-communes CSV row for this DGC carries the same six INSEE codes. Their union is the ~81 km2 detached part, ~37 km north of the Marlenheim end of the main vineyard. The small Gimbrett part near Berstett is also listed by name. The disjoint parts are expected.
whitelist.moschato-kefallinias: Poros outpost on Kefalonia. Under Β.Δ. 386/1971 as amended by Π.Δ. 242/1982, the ΠΟΠ Μοσχάτος Κεφαλληνίας zone is the Paliki peninsula (Δήμος Ληξουρίου plus the communities Σουλάρων, Ζύλων, Κατωγής, Σκηνέας and Χαυδάτων) plus 'την περιοχή της κοινότητας Πόρου της επαρχίας Κραναίας'. This is stated in the YPAAT product specification and in the eAmbrosia fiche technique Ares(2011)1411645, §5, NUTS GR223. The ~25.8 km² part ~25 km ESE of the Paliki main body (~38.13°N, 20.77°E) matches the GISCO LAU Δημοτική Κοινότητα Πόρου (EL_35010209) on Kefalonia's south-east coast. It is therefore legitimate, not a Bétard cross-attribution.
whitelist.terasele-dunarii: Danube-terrace IGP made of listed communes strung along ~300 km of the river, not one contiguous zone. The DOCUMENT UNIC (OJ C/2026/893, PGI-RO-A0113, section 6) lists the area county by county — 'judeţul Teleorman: municipiul Zimnicea cu localităţile componente; judeţul Giurgiu: comuna Daia …, comuna Greaca …, …; judeţul Ialomiţa …; judeţul Brăila …; judeţul Constanţa …'. Every resolved part is one of those listed communes (Zimnicea, Greaca, Izvoarele, Iepureşti, Lipniţa, Feteşti, Însurăţei), each scoped to the county the document puts it under; the ~134 km² westernmost part ~34 km from the Giurgiu group (~43.69°N, 25.37°E) is Oraş Zimnicea (RO_151978). Legitimate, not a homonym or parser leak.
whitelist.thraki: Samothrace. The ~181 km² part ~39 km S of the Thracian coast (~40.45°N, 25.58°E) is the island of Samothrace — GISCO LAU Ψευδοδημοτική Κοινότητα Σαμοθράκης (EL_03040000, 180.8 km², 98 % of the part) — inside NUTS-3 EL511 Έβρος. The ΥΠΑΑΤ product specification (raw/gr/national-specs-extracted/thraki.json, geo_area_brief; ΥΑ 259741/19.2.1997, ΦΕΚ 140/Β/3.3.1997, corrected ΦΕΚ 419/Β/20.4.1999) delimits the PGI as 'όλες τις περιοχές της Θράκης που περιγράφονται επακριβώς στις αντίστοιχες υπουργικές αποφάσεις' and cites 'a. whitelist.znojmo: Kojetice (CZ_590860, Třebíč district, 27 km NW of the Znojmo body). Vyhláška 254/2010 Sb. lists Kojetice among the obce of the Znojemská podoblast (raw/cz/national-specs/communes/znojemska.json); the Bétard polygon of PDO-CZ-A1086 carries it. Legitimate.
whitelist.calvados-spiritueux: Pays de Bray. The detached parts — Forges-les-Eaux, Londinières, Bailleul-Neuville (Seine-Maritime), Grémévillers, Sarnois (Oise), 36–79 km E of the main body — are rows of the INAO aires-communes CSV for the eau-de-vie 'Calvados' (raw/inao/aoc-aop-aires-communes.csv, IDA 2375 — the IGP wine of the same name is the Calvados département, IDA 1993, and is not detached): the aire extends over the Pays de Bray. Legitimate.
